args.title: Fix export filename date to use local time zone, not UTC
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

formatExportFilename builds the date suffix via at.toISOString().slice(0,10), which is always UTC, causing evening exports in zones behind UTC to get the next day's date. Change it to format the date using the exporting user's/report's local time zone (e.g. via a tz-aware helper like the existing localHour/Intl.DateTimeFormat in src/util/dates.ts).

args.title: Preserve '(copy)' suffix when duplicating long report names
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

In the POST /reports/:id/duplicate handler, the duplicate name is built as `${source.name} (copy)` and then truncated to MAX_NAME_LENGTH, which can cut off the ' (copy)' suffix for long source names, leaving a name indistinguishable from the original. Instead, truncate the source name first to leave room for ' (copy)', then append the suffix, so it's always preserved.

args.title: Preserve non-Latin letters in slugify for export filenames
args.body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

slugify() currently strips anything outside [a-z0-9] after NFKD normalization, which discards Greek/Cyrillic letters entirely (unlike accented Latin letters, which just lose diacritics). Update slugify to preserve non-Latin letters and digits (e.g. match on \p{L}\p{N} instead of [a-z0-9]), so formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts no longer falls back to 'report' for Greek/Cyrillic report names.
